tracks.title: certified
tracks.what: The ship: the dummy set down, CERTIFIED. D major pentatonic, 76 BPM. A ship's horn, plucked strings, bells, a gong at the climax

tracks.title: licensed
tracks.what: A run licensed. C major, 124 BPM. A chip lead over an arpeggio, four on the floor

tracks.title: failed test
tracks.what: A run failed. A minor, 66 BPM. A wobbling pad, a slow triangle line, plucked chords, a heartbeat

tracks.title: non-compliant
tracks.what: A refusal. E minor with its flat second, 100 BPM. Hold music: off-beat electric piano, a cold chime, a pulsing bass

tracks.title: tile cleared
tracks.what: A Story tile cleared, until the next card. G major, 132 BPM. A jingle (a rising arpeggio, a snare roll, a ta-da), then a bouncing loop that climbs back into it
